summary: Timely submission of creditor claims under IBC; 90-days period directory vs mandatory; arbitral award claim after COC approval; contingent liability treatment; prejudice to resolution process; RP's due diligence obligations; Supreme Court endorses NCLAT view on finality of CIRP timelines post-COC approval.
legal_provisions_cited: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code s.7, s.12, s.12A, s.19, s.31, s.60(5), s.61
Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 s.34, s.37
IBBI Regulations r.6, r.12, r.13, r.30A
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; NCLAT order upheld; rejection of belated claim sustained; no contingent liability provision required.
